Chapter 785: Chapter 9: Heaven, Earth, Humans, Ghosts, Gods, All Worship Martial Ancestor (Seeking Subscriptions)_2

After hundreds of thousands of years of development, the Martial Dao Cultivation System in the Tianqing World had become the only one, which was an achievement other worlds could not replicate.

In other traversing worlds, Lin Yuan still needed to consider the impact of the world’s consciousness, but in Tianqing World? Lin Yuan himself was the world consciousness!

Within the Tianqing World, the number of Martial Dao cultivators was incalculable. All of these would become the support for Lin Yuan’s ultimate leap in the future, and he could not just give them up easily.

The second reason was to explore the secrets of the mysterious, boundless void beyond the Tianqing World.

When Lin Yuan had left the Tianqing World, he had been only at the Seventh Rank, incapable of exploring the more vast and expansive boundless void.

But now, Lin Yuan was already at the Tenth Rank, and moreover, he was a heaven-defying Tenth Rank comparable to the peak of Tier 11.

...

Starting from the Fourth Layer of Tier 11, including the Fifth Layer, all could be considered the peak of Tier 11.

As for the Sixth Tier? That was the perfection of Tier 11.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, throughout the entire boundless void, not to say he was the strongest, but he was likely not far off, which was just the right time to descend and see, while also taking advantage of the different flow rates of time between the two worlds to quickly comprehend the Five-Layered Realm of Spacetime Fusion Rules.

As for the last aspect to consider… the cost-effectiveness was just too high.

Having the identity of the Heavenly Dao of the Tianqing World, Lin Yuan connecting the two worlds, if he chose to descend again, the cost of the World-Breaking Origin Force would be only one-third of a strand.

That’s right.

Not three strands.

Nor one strand.

But one-third of a strand.

You know, if Lin Yuan chose to traverse again now, except for the Immortal Realm, he would probably only be able to ‘custom’ traverse.

Lin Yuan’s level of strength was too powerful. In the Myriad Realms of the Heavens and the Endless Dimensional Planes, there were few worlds that could provide Lin Yuan with aid.

If he chose random traversal, he estimated that even after hundreds or thousands of times, it would be meaningless.

And then there was the Tianqing World, although not as supreme as the Immortal Realm, but it was cheap, wasn’t it? With one-third of a strand of World-Breaking Origin Force, what other requirements could there be?

And those Foreign Evil Gods, wielding numerous talents and authoritative powers, involved many mysterious rules. Last time in the Tianqing World, Lin Yuan could only study the Ancestral Demon Tree.

Lacking in numbers, this time it was just right to capture more Foreign Evil Gods for study, which might help enhance his own cultivation.

That is the boundless void different from the Main Universe and even the dimension where Chaos Void exists.

The differences between dimensions, even those beings approaching Perfect Time Beings, find it difficult to make contact.

The low-dimensional space in that piece of White Paper is the product of a being close to a Perfect Time Being exploring the lower-dimensional worlds.

Lin Yuan, with the aid of the Door to the Myriad Realms, can research at will and naturally must seize this opportunity.

…

Having decided to descend to the Tianqing World again, Lin Yuan made some preparations.

Traversing through worlds, Lin Yuan’s consciousness would leave along the Door to the Myriad Realms, and by that time his physical body would be akin to an empty shell.

Of course, with the Door to the Myriad Realms maintained, even if Lin Yuan’s consciousness was in other dimensional worlds, he could sense the situations around his True Spiritual Body and could completely stop the traversal and forcefully return at any necessary moment.

“Almost there.”

A moment later, Lin Yuan’s consciousness came before the Door to the Myriad Realms again.

Actually, there wasn’t much to prepare, as the twelve Guiding Spaces of the black planet, Lin Yuan had already completely comprehended, and the Incarnation placed there had long returned.

So even if the spirit will left, it wouldn’t delay anything.

The few effects that remain concern the Incarnation situated in the Xia You Evolution Tower, currently comprehending the Cosmic Aurora.

But Lin Yuan had just told Xia Qin Supreme Being because of reasons related to cultivation, he needed to withdraw all Incarnations.

Inside each Incarnation, there was a strand of spirit will of the corresponding powerhouse, and withdrawing this strand of spirit will, for the sake of ensuring one’s own condition, is quite common among human civilization’s Evolvers.

As for the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses’ comprehension of the Spatio-temporal Fusion Rules and other five light orbs… to be strict, these five light orbs are also considered ‘items’, as long as Lin Yuan is willing to pay the World-Breaking Origin Force, he can freely bring them into the Tianqing World.

Now, Lin Yuan’s accumulated World-Breaking Origin Force was already close to a thousand strands, which qualifies as financially robust, able to afford bringing those five light orbs into the Tianqing World.

“This time, the stay will again be six hundred years.”

“If all goes well, once the traversal ends, a year will have passed in the Main World.”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, silently thinking.

“Almost there.”

“Let’s begin.”

Lin Yuan looked towards the majestic and grand Door to the Myriad Realms and immediately chose to traverse.

Due to the difference in the flow rate of time, every second in the Main Universe translates into six hundred times the time flow rate in the Tianqing World.

And given the current situation in the Tianqing World, already breached by those two Foreign Evil Gods, any further delay would have an even greater impact on the entire world.

Humm.

The next instant.

All of Lin Yuan’s spirit will surged into the Door to the Myriad Realms.

This spirit will included his True Body as well as the two Primordial Spirits.

Fortunately, Lin Yuan had already placed the two Primordial Spirits in safe locations, so no issues would arise.

…

Tianqing World.

Upon the vast lands, endless Evil God Puppets wreaked havoc, and a terrifying crack appeared in the sky dome, with a multitude of Evil God Puppets rapidly pouring in.

Beyond that terrifying crack, faintly stood two towering figures, sinister, and evil aura pervaded, their blood-red eyes staring into the world.

The beings of the Tianqing World, having to resist the invasion of the Evil Gods, were forced to come to the central part of the world, under the World Tree that supported the heavens and the earth.

Protected by the power of the World Tree, as the Heaven-Reaching Vine Branches gently swayed, billions upon billions of Evil God Puppets were annihilated.
